'''Jai''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] as a [[Nurse/Legends|Nurse]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Jai worked at the [[Dreviad Medcenter]] where she was helping [[Rowan Delk]] to recover from the [[Sand Rot]], an illness caused by prolonged desert exposure. He derisively called her "Darth Nurse" for her overbearing nature.
